sentences.text: T he applicant is in custody since 04.10.2023.
Conclusion of trial will take a sufficient long time.
Under these circumstances, counsel prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
4. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the application and prayed to its rejection.

5. Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, nature of the allegations and custody period of the applicant and readiness to deposit the received amount, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.

Consequently, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed under the following conditions:-
i. Subject to depositing total amount of Rs.5,00,000/- out of which Rs. 2,50,000/-
shall be deposited by the applicant at the time of furnishing bail bond before the trial Court and on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
ii. He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C..
iii. After being enlarged on bail, the applicant shall deposit Rs.2,50,000/- within a period of three months.
6. This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
7. It is for the trial Court to deposit the entire amount so deposited by the applicant as directed aforesaid, with any nationalized bank fetching maximum interest rate.
Disbursal of the same shall be subject to final outcome of the trial.
8. In case of failure to comply with any condition, this order shall stands recalled without further reference to this Court.
Certified copy as per rules.
